Game Overview

In Finders Critters, the core idea is straightforward: help adorable critters reach the ground by skillfully matching blocks in this engaging puzzle game. Strategize your moves to avoid dead ends and unlock quirky characters and explosive tools. With its charming design and straightforward gameplay, Finders Critters offers endless fun for all ages.
